notes.title: v1.2 update
notes.content:
● Normal difficulty has been added. Select the Normal difficulty in Config to make the game go faster
● Modify the unlock condition for MachineGun Mode to unlock earlier
● Modified cost requirements for MachineGun Mode
● Increased the winning bonus
● Changed some of the interface and text colors
● Some teaching entries have been added

● Thank you for your valuable comments and bug reports in evaluation! Or Welcome to sneer me :)
